critical_conclusions: No critical conclusions require user attention or action.
scope: Static prose only in both rendered HTML reports. Issue, case, reason-group, and acceptance-criterion descriptions were excluded.
conclusion: Seven small wording corrections are suggested. No metric values, source dates, execution results, or priorities need changing.

findings.replace: Session Refresh · Release report · Evidence assessed 29 October 2026 · Wording updated 30 October 2026
findings.reason: Distinguish the presentation date from the retained evidence date. Keep all source and execution dates unchanged.

findings.replace: Required behaviors passed in local tests

also_replace.All 7 requirements link to code and test: All 7 required behaviors link to code and tests.

findings.reason: The denominator is seven acceptance criteria. Calling them seven requirements can misstate the scope.
Partial and blocked cases also have recorded results. This label explains the 197-case numerator directly.

findings.find: 36 changed files received historical review, with the later Timeout change also inspected. A complete independent review of the current candidate is unavailable.
findings.replace: An earlier review covered 36 changed files. The later Timeout change was also inspected. The complete current code has no independent review.
findings.reason: Replace historical review and current candidate with plain descriptions.

findings.find: What “changed paths with selected tests” meant

also_replace.It meant: each of 12 changed runtime sou: Each of 12 changed application files has at least one relevant test that passed.
also_replace.The comparison has 36 changed paths: 12: The comparison contains 36 changed files: 12 application files and 24 test or configuration files. Six application files change behavior. Six contain maintenance changes.

findings.reason: Explain the metric using files. Avoid repeating path, runtime, and maintenance terminology without context.

findings.find: The priorities below apply now. Potential severity remains separate from priority.
findings.replace: The priorities below apply now. Severity describes possible harm. Priority describes how urgently we need to act.
findings.reason: Explain why severity and priority are different.

findings.find: Passing observation cases record behavior. They do not establish that the behavior is acceptable.
findings.replace: Some tests pass because they confirm the observed behavior. That behavior can still reveal a defect.
findings.reason: Explain why a passing test can appear in the risk list.

next_action: Apply the suggested static-copy replacements, then validate the rendered reports.

limitations: This is an editorial review. It does not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
